data.reasoning: The package is a standard VCS (-git) AUR package. The PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO contain normal metadata and build instructions without any malicious code, unexpected network requests, or execution of untrusted content. The disagreement was solely due to an API error in the first model.
data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model encountered an HTTP 400 API error when attempting to review .SRCINFO, resulting in an inconclusive verdict for that file and the overall package. The deepseek model successfully reviewed .SRCINFO and correctly identified it as safe standard metadata.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review .SRCINFO due to an API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for transient API errors (like HTTP 400/500) during file review to prevent a single file failure from rendering the entire audit inconclusive.
When aggregating multiple model reports, a successful review of a file by one model should override an inconclusive result caused by a tool error from another model.
